item.title: Welcome to Curiosities
item.description: What this site is, what is on it, and what the essays will be.
item.content:encoded:
Essay · 22 August 2026

Welcome to Curiosities

This is where the first essay will go. The essays will appear fortnightly and can be followed by RSS; the feed is at feed.xml.

Until the text is written, this page stands in for it so that the list, the feed and the links all work.
